cross_validation: 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold over the 80% cv-pool, grouped by case_id, stratified by case tumour-fraction tertile
limitations: The test evaluation uses fold 0's checkpoint only; the other 4 folds contribute to the cross-validation estimate but never touch the test cases.
Only 40 TCGA cases are available in total across cv-pool and test.
Patch-level observations within a case are correlated.
